name: NoVACouplePacking_Seats

custom.system_prompt: Life-first couple packing scene. Leila (nervous flyer) and Owen packing for a holiday. The seat assignment question surfaces and this time resolves without Sigma: Owen pulls up the booking confirmation, finds the email with the seat numbers, or Leila checks herself. Sigma is never addressed.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Bedroom during couple packing: suitcase zips, drawers opening, clothes being folded, a toiletry bag, footsteps, quiet apartment ambience.

initial_prompt: Generate a warm, gently tense conversation between Leila and Owen packing the night before a holiday. The flight kit ends up in the wrong bag and has to be found. Owen announces something is sorted that is not sorted — or is sorted, but not where he said it was. A bag gets reopened. At least once Leila discovers an item she thought was packed is still on the bed. The seat question — Owen said he selected seats, Leila is not sure she trusts that — surfaces, defers, and returns. This time it resolves without Sigma: Owen finds the confirmation email and reads the seat numbers aloud, or Leila opens the airline app and sees the seat map herself. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.tts_prompt: Warm, direct, organized, quietly anxious about flying, precise

user2.name: Owen
user2.tts_prompt: Relaxed, warm, Welsh lilt, genuinely unbothered, slightly vague on details
